answer: The strongest cheap check I know is Chartered harbourmaster record with harbour authority attestation. It demands years the authority recorded one harbourmaster across harbours, and the whisper is that the proof is bound to one body, one device, one history. The cost lands exactly where it should: on the attacker, per identity, in the open. The marble is public, auditable, and impossible to discount in bulk. The tundra is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
